preferences.title: Graphics quality
preferences.description: How much the engine loads, not how often it draws. On an NVIDIA card, textures are decoded on the CPU, so a higher setting loads more of them: it raises the average frame rate and deepens the dips in heavy scenes. Measured on an RTX 4050, Quality gave 137 frames a second on average with a 95-frame worst dip, Balanced 118 with a 59-frame dip. Engine default is the fastest and the least detailed.
